name: is_palindrome
description: Return true if s reads the same forwards and backwards. Must be recursive (no loops). Case-sensitive; the empty string is a palindrome.

name: power
signature: long long power(long long base, unsigned int exponent);
description: Compute base^exponent recursively in O(log n) multiplications using repeated squaring. power(x, 0) == 1.

name: gcd
description: Greatest common divisor via Euclid's algorithm, recursively. Handle zero and negative inputs (result is always >= 0).

name: fibonacci_memo
signature: unsigned long long fibonacci(unsigned int n);
description: Return the nth Fibonacci number (fib(0)=0, fib(1)=1) using recursion with memoization so fibonacci(90) returns instantly.

name: sum_digits
description: Recursively sum the decimal digits of n. Negative numbers use their absolute value.

name: reverse_string
description: Return s reversed, using recursion (no loops, no std::reverse).

name: count_occurrences
signature: template <class T> int countOccurrences(const std::vector<T>& items, const T& target);
description: Recursively count how many times target appears in items.

name: towers_of_hanoi
signature: std::vector<std::pair<int, int>> towersOfHanoi(int disks, int from, int to, int spare);
description: Return the sequence of moves (from peg, to peg) that solves Towers of Hanoi. Tests should verify the move count is 2^n - 1 and that every move is legal.

name: permutations
description: Return every permutation of s (duplicates allowed if s has repeated letters). Tests may sort the result before comparing.

name: power_set
description: Return all 2^n subsets of items, recursively.

name: n_queens
description: Count the number of ways to place n non-attacking queens on an n x n board using backtracking. countNQueens(8) == 92.

name: flood_fill
signature: void floodFill(std::vector<std::string>& grid, int row, int col, char replacement);
description: Recursively replace the connected region (4-directional) containing grid[row][col] with replacement, like the paint-bucket tool.

name: count_grid_paths
signature: long long countGridPaths(int rows, int cols);
description: Count paths from the top-left to the bottom-right of a grid moving only right or down. Use memoization.

name: bubble_sort
description: Sort ascending with bubble sort. Stop early if a pass makes no swaps.

name: selection_sort
description: Sort ascending with selection sort.

name: insertion_sort
description: Sort ascending with insertion sort.

name: shell_sort
description: Sort ascending with Shell sort using the gap sequence n/2, n/4, ..., 1.

name: merge_sort
description: Sort ascending with recursive merge sort. Must be stable (add a test that proves it).

name: quick_sort
description: Sort ascending with recursive quicksort using median-of-three pivot selection.

name: heap_sort
description: Sort ascending in place with heap sort (build a max-heap, then repeatedly extract).

name: counting_sort
description: Sort non-negative integers with counting sort. Throw std::invalid_argument on a negative value.

name: radix_sort
description: Sort non-negative integers with LSD radix sort (base 10). Throw std::invalid_argument on a negative value.

name: is_sorted
signature: template <class T> bool isSorted(const std::vector<T>& items);
description: Return true if items is in non-decreasing order. Useful for testing every other sort.

name: linear_search
signature: template <class T> int linearSearch(const std::vector<T>& items, const T& target);
description: Return the index of the first occurrence of target, or -1.

name: interpolation_search
signature: int interpolationSearch(const std::vector<int>& items, int target);
description: Interpolation search over a sorted vector of ints. Return the index or -1. Guard against division by zero.

name: quickselect
signature: template <class T> T kthSmallest(std::vector<T> items, int k);
description: Return the kth smallest element (k is 1-based) in expected O(n) time using quickselect. Throw std::out_of_range for an invalid k.

name: balanced_brackets
description: Return true if every (, [, { is closed in the right order. Use h235::LinkedStack. Ignore all other characters.

name: evaluate_postfix
description: Evaluate a space-separated postfix expression of integers and + - * / using h235::LinkedStack. Throw std::invalid_argument on malformed input.

name: infix_to_postfix
description: Convert an infix expression with single-letter operands, + - * / and parentheses into postfix, respecting precedence. Use h235::LinkedStack.

name: reverse_words
description: Reverse the order of words in a sentence using h235::LinkedStack. Collapse runs of spaces into one.

name: next_greater_element
description: For each element, return the next element to its right that is larger, or -1. Must run in O(n) using a stack.

name: min_stack
signature: template <class T> class MinStack { push, pop, peek, getMin, isEmpty };
description: A stack that also returns its minimum element in O(1). Build it on top of h235::LinkedStack.

name: hot_potato
signature: std::string hotPotato(const std::vector<std::string>& names, int passes);
description: Simulate the hot-potato (Josephus) game with h235::LinkedQueue: pass the potato `passes` times, eliminate the holder, repeat. Return the winner.

name: palindrome_stack_queue
description: Check whether s is a palindrome by pushing every letter onto a LinkedStack and a LinkedQueue and comparing. Ignore case and non-letters.

name: grid_shortest_path
description: Breadth-first search with h235::LinkedQueue from 'S' to 'E' through '.' cells (walls are '#'). Return the number of steps, or -1 if unreachable.

name: reverse_chain
description: Reverse a chain of h235::Node in place and return the new head. Tests must free every node they allocate.

name: merge_sorted_chains
signature: template <class T> Node<T>* mergeSortedChains(Node<T>* a, Node<T>* b);
description: Merge two sorted chains into one sorted chain by relinking nodes (no new nodes). Return the new head.

name: remove_duplicates_chain
description: Remove duplicate values from a sorted chain, deleting the removed nodes.

name: chain_middle
description: Return the middle node in one pass using slow/fast pointers. For an even length, return the second middle.

name: has_cycle
signature: template <class T> bool hasCycle(const Node<T>* head);
description: Detect a cycle with Floyd's tortoise-and-hare algorithm in O(1) extra space.

name: array_stack
signature: template <class T> class ArrayStack { isEmpty, size, push, pop, peek };
description: A stack backed by a dynamically resizing array (double the capacity when full). Follow the Rule of Three. Match LinkedStack's interface.

name: circular_array_queue
signature: template <class T> class ArrayQueue { isEmpty, size, enqueue, dequeue, peekFront };
description: A queue backed by a circular array that grows when full. Follow the Rule of Three. Match LinkedQueue's interface.

name: sorted_linked_list
signature: template <class T> class SortedLinkedList { insertSorted, removeSorted, getPosition, getEntry, getLength, isEmpty, clear };
description: A list that keeps its entries in ascending order, as in the textbook's Sorted List ADT. Follow the Rule of Three.

name: binary_search_tree
signature: template <class T> class BinarySearchTree { add, remove, contains, getHeight, getNumberOfNodes, inorder, clear };
description: A binary search tree with linked nodes. inorder() returns a std::vector<T>. Follow the Rule of Three. remove() must handle the two-children case.

name: priority_queue
signature: template <class T> class HeapPriorityQueue { add, remove, peek, isEmpty, size };
description: A max-priority queue backed by an array-based binary heap.

name: hash_map
signature: template <class K, class V> class HashMap { put, get, remove, contains, size };
description: A hash map using separate chaining with h235::Node. Rehash when the load factor exceeds 0.75. get() throws std::out_of_range for a missing key.
